summary: Surveyed all 1517 listed .lean files (7441374 bytes; 113 under library directories such as HexGF2, HexLLLMathlib, HexPrimality, HexRealClosure, HexRoots; 1404 under bench/, mostly ProofProbe modules). A line-start grep for theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque (with private/protected/noncomputable/partial/unsafe/meta/attribute prefixes) found 11777 declarations in 1124 files and 0 in 393 files (1 library aggregator, 392 bench files). The 393 zero-declaration files were classified by their non-comment commands: 107 are import-only or module/public-import aggregators, and the rest add set_option/open, #eval runner calls, #print axioms audits, #guard checks, run_meta/run_cmd kernel-timing canaries, or custom probe commands that state formal propositions (e.g. real_formula_probe). None was shown to be exactly duplicated elsewhere, and FILTER-007/FILTER-004 require a verified auxiliary channel for their module identity and import edges before any removal, which is not established. The largest files (HexPrimality/Table.lean, the 220 KB RowReduce Inverse probes) hold theorems with proofs. Disposition: retain every file.
